diagnosis.what_happened: The orchestrator and writer generated 2 tables for simple regression but collapsed multiple regression and logistic regression into single combined tables.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Lack of a unified multi-regression schema led the agent to combine model fit and coefficient columns into ad-hoc single tables.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Each hypothesis comprising simple, multiple, and logistic regressions must contain exactly 7 tables: 1 correlation table, 2 tables for simple regression, 2 tables for multiple regression, and 2 tables for logistic regression.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Maintaining institutional standard separation between overall model fit (ANOVA/Omnibus) and individual predictor effects (Coefficients/OR) is mandatory.

desired_behavior: Enforce the canonical 7-Table Suite per hypothesis: Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (Simple ANOVA/Summary), Table 3 (Simple Coeffs), Table 4 (Multiple ANOVA/Summary), Table 5 (Multiple Coeffs), Table 6 (Logistic Omnibus & Fit), Table 7 (Logistic Variables in Equation & OR).
generalization: Mixed-method regression hypotheses must structurally map to a 7-table suite decomposing fit vs. predictors.

evidence.observed_value: Collapsed single tables for multiple/logistic regression
